Build Intelligent Systems That Create Real Impact

Are you motivated by solving complex problems with data and AI?

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

About VENZO

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

About the Role

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies within AI and GenAI

For more senior candidates, the role also includes:

• Defining technical direction and architectural standards

• Acting as a primary technical contact for clients

• Leading workstreams and mentoring team members

• Contributing to the evolution of our Data & AI capabilities and service offerings

We value profiles who can combine deep technical execution with sound judgment in real client environments.

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience

• 2+ years of experience in data engineering or AI/ML, delivering production-ready solutions

• Hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle — from experimentation to deployment and monitoring

• Experience with generative AI

• For senior profiles: experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring others

Technical Capabilities

You have experience working within modern data and AI ecosystems, including:

• Programming: Python and SQL, Typescript is a plus

• Cloud: Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure ML, Data Factory) or other cloud plattforms

• Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow)

• Machine Learning: Classical ML techniques and generative AI applications

• GenAI Tooling: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, frameworks such as LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework

• MLOps: CI/CD, model lifecycle management, orchestration tools, version control

• Data Engineering: ETL processes and large-scale data processing

How You Work

• Analytical and structured in your problem-solving approach

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

What You Can Expect From Us

• Meaningful, technically challenging projects with real business visibility

• A strong professional environment with high standards and high trust

• Autonomy in how you structure and deliver your work

• Access to modern tooling, platforms, and certifications (including Microsoft)

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Continuous development — technically and professionally

Let’s Talk

Send your CV or a short introduction to hr@venzo.com.

We’re happy to meet for a coffee and explore whether there’s a mutual fit.

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Join Charlie Tango, a specialised unit within KMD

Charlie Tango is a multidisciplinary consultancy within KMD, bringing together around 40 specialists across design, strategy, technology, AI and innovation.

Together, we combine Charlie Tango’s hands-on approach to design and innovation with KMD’s deep domain knowledge and experience developing critical digital solutions that help shape the future of society.

AI is transforming how we explore ideas, create experiences and build digital products. At the same time, growing complexity demands stronger design systems, smarter processes and a more systematic approach to design.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who is excited by both. Someone with excellent visual and UI design skills, a strong understanding of UX, and a genuine passion for design craft, combined with a deep interest in the systems, processes and practices that enable great design at scale.

Be part of our multidisciplinary design team

You will join our Product Design team, part of Charlie Tango’s Experience Design department of approximately 15 designers, spanning UX, Service Design, UI, Motion Design and Branding.

Your primary focus will be on UI, interaction design and design systems, working closely with our Service & UX Design team, frontend developers and product owners.

Your role

As a Senior Product Designer, you will take a leading role in shaping digital products, experiences and

the practices behind them.

You will take ownership of the design process, working from user needs and business challenges

through concepts, interactions and high-quality visual execution.

You are a hands-on designer who can navigate complex challenges, facilitate collaboration and advise clients on how to improve their design

practices.

With a particular focus on Process Design, Design Systems, DesignOps and Accessibility, you will help

organisations develop and implement better ways of working, while remaining closely involved in the

design work itself.

Your work will typically include:

• Creating digital products and interfaces. Develop high-quality visual and interaction design,

from concepts and prototypes to detailed UI and production-ready designs.

• Designing processes and ways of working. Map workflows, identify challenges and develop

practical processes that improve collaboration, decision-making and delivery.

• Building and evolving Design Systems. Develop components, design standards and governance

models, and help organisations implement and adopt them.

• Advancing DesignOps and Accessibility. Help clients establish effective design practices,

accessibility standards and processes that support consistent, inclusive digital experiences.

• Facilitating and advising. Lead workshops, collaborate with stakeholders and translate complex

needs into clear design directions and practical solutions.

• Exploring AI in design. Use AI-assisted tools and automation in your own work, experiment with

new workflows and help clients identify opportunities to improve their design processes.

• Developing our design practice. Share knowledge, challenge existing methods and contribute to

the development of our Experience Design team.

What you bring

We imagine you have 5+ years of relevant experience, ideally from a consultancy, agency or

complex product organisation. You are first and foremost a skilled visual and digital product designer,

with a portfolio that demonstrates strong UI craft, attention to detail and experience creating digital

products and working with large-scale design systems.

In detail:

• Excellent visual and UI design skills, including typography, colour, layout, interaction patterns,

prototyping and detailed interface design.

• A strong understanding of UX, user behaviour and the principles of human-centred design.

• A systematic and analytical mindset, with a genuine interest in Process Design, workflows and

improving how teams work.

• Practical experience with Design Systems and DesignOps, including components, governance,

implementation and cross-functional collaboration.

• Deep accessibility expertise, including WCAG and the ability to independently advise on inclusive

design and its implementation.

• Strong facilitation and consultancy skills, with the confidence to work directly with clients and

multidisciplinary teams.

• Advanced Figma skills, and an active interest in AI-assisted design workflows and emerging

technologies.

• Excellent communication skills in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Why join Charlie Tango?

At Charlie Tango, you become part of a close-knit specialist environment with the reach and

opportunities of a major technology organisation as part of KMD.

You will work on meaningful digital challenges across public and private sectors, including solutions that

support essential functions in Danish society. You will collaborate with experienced designers, advisors

and engineers in an environment that values craft, curiosity, precision and new ideas.

You will also join at a time when AI and emerging technologies are changing both what we design and

how we design it, creating opportunities to explore new approaches and influence the future of our

practice.

We offer a high degree of professional autonomy, varied challenges and opportunities for professional

development and knowledge sharing.

You will be employed by KMD in a full-time position, based at Charlie Tango's office in Østerbro,

Copenhagen, with a competitive salary package, pension and employee benefits in accordance with

KMD's employment terms. You will report to the Head of Design.

Interested?

We would love to see how you think, how you work, what you have created and how you envision an

AI-driven future.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so send us your CV (or LinkedIn profile) and a link to your portfolio,ideally including examples of digital product design as well as work involving Design Systems, Process Design, DesignOps or Accessibility.

Applications are handled through KMD's recruitment process. We welcome qualified candidates from

different backgrounds and experiences.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Manager, Head of Design, Frederik Aagaard at fag@kmd.dk or +45 51 22 99 02.

Come help us design digital experiences that matter, and shape how we design them.

Benefits:

KMD (an NEC company) is committed to providing equal opportunities. Hence, we invite all qualified interested applicants to apply for career opportunities. At KMD all aspects of employment and cooperation including the decision to hire/cooperate with will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other status protected under local anti-discrimination legislation.

jobs.description:
Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind, as well as other non-hydro renewable initiatives like PV/Solar and batteries. We currently develop, construct and operate wind generation assets across Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK.

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

We are looking for several Senior Project Engineers to strengthen our offshore transmission engineering capabilities within Business Area Wind, Offshore, Engineering.

We are seeking engineers with experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Offshore substations

• Onshore substations

• Offshore export cables

• Onshore export cables

We welcome engineers from all relevant disciplines across these scopes, with particular interest in HV and LV systems for onshore and offshore substations, and civil engineering for onshore substations and onshore export cable routes. Your assigned scope will reflect your background and experience.

You will take ownership of assigned engineering work packages, from FEED and tendering through delivery and handover.

In these roles, you will apply your experience to shape and challenge supplier solutions from the owner’s perspective, coordinate technical expertise and resolve delivery issues.

Within the project, you will report to the respective Package Manager and work autonomously within your assigned scope, drawing on technical specialists and collaborating with Interface Managers, Procurement and other project functions.

Your responsibilities:

• 
Deliver assigned engineering work packages in accordance with contractual requirements and project and contract milestones. Plan and coordinate activities, and monitor and report on safety, quality, progress and cost within your scope.

•
